t: MCPP (Mecoprop) - Active Ingredient Page — Chemical Warehouse
s: August 15, 2024 - Type: Herbicide Mode of Action: Mimicking the plant hormone auxin Common Product Names: Powerzone & Mecoturf What is it? Mecoprop (MCPP) is a selective postemergent, systemic herbicide belonging to the phenoxy herbicide group. It is commonly used to control a wide range of broadleaf weeds, such as dandelions, chickweed, and clover, in lawns, turf, and certain crop fields.
